text_block_list.name: Trendy Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way! Isn't that the "Villainess"!? I'm 
totally taking a picture~♪

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Ramonu! Yesterday's interview article 
has caused quite a stir on social media, 
could you give us a comment—

As a result of stirring up the public 
again and again, over the past two years, 
the "Villainess" became the talk of the 
town.

As a result, she is hounded daily by 
aggressive journalists and onlookers, 
leaving her with fewer and fewer moments 
of peace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "So, a vacation?"
choice_data_list:
Because I found a place where you can get 
plenty of rest—

Because I found a place where you can get 
plenty of rest—

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Ramonu-san! Are you going far 
away for some secret training!?
choice_data_list: 君が存分に休める場所を見つけたから――
貴方が存分に休める場所を見つけたから――
choice_data_list_en: I found a place where you can get plenty of rest, so—
I found a place where you can rest to your heart's content――

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Where are you heading off to now, miss?!? 
Please answer meee!
choice_data_list: 嘘だろ！もう嗅ぎつけられた……！？
嘘でしょ！もう嗅ぎつけられた……！？
choice_data_list_en: No way! They've already sniffed us out...?!
No way! They've already sniffed us out...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're quite devoted to your work, 
aren't you?
choice_data_list: I'm off today! Well then, bye!

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Ms. Ramonuuu! Huh, she's not here?!
choice_data_list: 今日はオフなので！それでは！
choice_data_list_en: Today's my day off! So if you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... Even though uncovering secrets 
is your specialty—
choice_data_list:
If you step too far forward, they'll spot 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "You too. Come closer."
choice_data_list: あまり前に出ると見つかるから……！
choice_data_list_en: If you step out too far, they'll spot you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And? Where to next—

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Ramonu-san! Running away means 
you have a guilty conscience, doesn't it?!
choice_data_list: ...Ngh! Leave this to me and go on ahead!
...Ngh! Leave this to me and go on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Hey!? What gives? Stop getting in my 
wa—
choice_data_list: ……っ！ここは俺に任せて先に行って！
……っ！ここは私に任せて先に行って！
choice_data_list_en: ...! Leave this to me and go on ahead!
...! Leave this to me and go on ahead!

text_block_list.text:
Afterward—we somehow managed to shake off 
the reporters and reach our destination.
choice_data_list: My clothes are totally ruined... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—
choice_data_list: 服がすっかりボロボロだ……でも
choice_data_list_en: Your clothes are completely in tatters... but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, hehe... Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I love you... I love you, "You," with all 
of my heart!

A field spreading as far as the eye can 
see, without a soul in sight. With the 
innocent face of a young maiden, she ran 
as if dancing.

"To become evil for the sake of the races 
I love." It was an expression I hadn't 
seen ever since making that resolution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You look like you're having fun.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're always smiling, after all.
choice_data_list: えっ

text_block_list.text:
"That applies more to you, Ramonu," I 
almost said, but stopped myself.
choice_data_list: ...Promise you won't laugh, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu running in her Make Debut 
looked as if she were crying—and that is 
why.
choice_data_list: ……笑わないで聞いてほしいんだけど
choice_data_list_en: ...Promise you won't laugh, but hear me out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
choice_data_list: 今、君が楽しそうでよかったなって
今、貴方が楽しそうでよかったなって
choice_data_list_en: I was just thinking how glad I am to see you having fun.
I was just thinking how glad I am to see you having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because... it's so strange.
choice_data_list: わ、笑わないでって言ったのに！
choice_data_list_en: I-I told you not to laugh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"So devoted, you are. With soiled clothes 
and a tired face."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a single benefit to it, and 
yet...
choice_data_list:
It's just... I only wanted to thank you, 
that's all

text_block_list.text:
Because Mejiro Ramonu raised her voice, 
the racing world shifted, and the old 
passion returned. That is why—
choice_data_list: それは……ただ、感謝したかっただけだから
choice_data_list_en: That was... just because I wanted to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Gratitude.
choice_data_list: 熱いレースを取り戻してくれたお礼だよ
choice_data_list_en: It's my thanks for bringing back that fierce racing spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Gratitude. Yes.
